understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate the grid, modify the carried piece's shape, color, and rotation as needed, and step onto every goal cell only when all three attributes match its requirements. Completing all goals advances through the levels until the game is won.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move costs one stamina, and reaching zero stamina costs a life while restoring stamina to its maximum; losing all lives ends the game. Walls block movement, so blocked_directions must be checked before every move. Shape modifiers cycle shapes 0–5, color modifiers cycle orange to blue to green to red and back to orange, and rotation modifiers rotate clockwise through 0°, 90°, 180°, and 270°. Goals activate only when shape, color, and rotation simultaneously match.
